title: Energy transfer and transformation

draft.title: Energy transfer and transformation
card: Energy moves from one object to another, and its form stays the same. When a hot pan warms your hand, heat energy passes from the pan to your hand.
Energy changes from one form to another. In a battery-powered torch, chemical energy in the battery becomes electrical energy.
Both can happen in one event. A kicked football gains movement energy from the foot (a transfer). The kicker's stored chemical energy became movement energy in the leg (a transformation).
To tell them apart, ask one question: did the energy change form, or did it only move to a new object?
draft.remember: Transfer: same energy form, new object. Transformation: new energy form.

a.q: A hot cup of tea warms the hands of the person holding it. Heat energy passes from the cup to their hands. What is this?
opts: An energy transfer, because the form stays the same
An energy transformation, because the energy is used up
An energy transformation, because the hands get warm
An energy transfer, because the energy changes its form
a.why: The energy is heat before and after, and it only moves from the cup to the hands, so it is a transfer. Hands getting warm may seem like a change, but the energy form has not changed.
a.clue: Did the form of the energy change, or only where it is?

b.q: Mia's solar-powered calculator in Perth works in bright light. Which statement describes what the solar cell does?
opts: It transforms light energy into electrical energy
It transfers light energy to the calculator unchanged
It transforms electrical energy into light energy
It transfers electrical energy into another object as light
b.why: Light arrives and electrical energy comes out, so the form changes. That is a transformation. Calling it a transfer is tempting because the energy moves into the calculator, but the form is different.
b.clue: Compare the energy form going in with the form coming out.

a.best: An energy transfer, because the form stays the same

b.best: It transforms light energy into electrical energy
